text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Narita Brian out in a field pulling weeds with the groundskeeper.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is such a pain! How much more do we have to do?!

text_block_list.name: Groundskeeper
text_block_list.text: Punishment. She walked through the field and trampled the seedlings, so I'm having her pull weeds.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I said I didn't mean to, didn't I?! Damn! It's really not my day!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Fine! I'll make this into a field of despair! Get ready, weeds!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian pulls weeds savagely, but stooping over all day pulling weeds must be tiring, even for her…
